1. Preliminary Knowledge

1.1 About Coordinates

To describe the position of a point P in the plane xOy we introduce coordinates. For example, how are the coordinates (4, 3) of point P obtained?

Intuitively, starting from the origin, P moves 4 units along the positive x-axis and then 3 units along the positive y-axis to reach (4, 3).
